fusions.name: Run Down at Last
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A lunge up to 6 tiles that deals 24 poison damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Scent on the Tongue
fusions.desc: Flicks venom that deals 4 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Tongue Reads the Wind
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Next Scent Already
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
